result.summary:
Design basis: baseline is the 1.4.0 HTTP JSON API plus read-only CLI and a version-1 DATA_FILE (decision 8 at 499974b). Delta keeps that process and file; adds due on the ticket, hours env, an HTTP projector, and overdue as an extra AND. State owner is TicketStore; due lifetime is the ticket; crash recovery is the existing temp-plus-rename, plus a start-time backfill save because open() does not write. Channel is HTTP request/response; hours and DUE_TIMES are process env at start; no cache, push, extra worker, or flag service. UI: none (headless JSON and unchanged CLI). Safeguard: onlyFields refuses client due. Deployment: source-only; request names no target.

Queue: one item W1. Projector must land with store due because R-8 and DT-1 require flag-off HTTP to omit due; the existing 117 tests compare POST to GET or pick named keys and would still pass if due leaked (A10 corrected). parseListQuery default return { filters, limit, after } is an R-10 seam for overdue (A12). Omitted hours on TicketStore must default to 4/24/72/168 (A13) or store.create throws RangeError. Overdue shares the list path and due field and has no extra prerequisite. Tests live in one file. No repair, bootstrap, environment-prep, or deploy item. Frozen 1.4.0 persistence is W1 test-authoring setup. AD-8 1.5.0 at W1 document. Architecture Structure records environments, namespaces, the version-1 due field, and the R-10 seams; AD-1..AD-8 kept, no new AD.

Backchain route: host five-lens audit plus printed backchain-check on RUN/scratch/plan-candidate.json. No source-aware-native child (seams and DT map already recorded; nested Until Loop is plan-only). Receipt check-15b35e989b24.json: valid, incomplete (residual A7 production DATA_FILE). Parallel group S1 config with S2 persistence.

NFR: compatibility R-1/R-9/R-10; operability R-3/R-7/R-8/R-9 plus AD-8; reliability backfill save; security due not writable; performance and accessibility excluded; observability no audit for due/backfill; delivery source-only.

Assumptions A1–A6 evidenced, A8 probed, A9–A11 evidenced, A10 corrected and evidenced, A12 probed, A13 probed (hours default on TicketStore), A7 open due_item W1.
